caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair positioned centrally on the page, with ornate carving on the backrest and a dark, textured upholstered seat. The chair is depicted in three-quarter view, revealing four curved legs and a decorative splat in the center of the backrest. The wood of the chair is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, while the seat is a dark gray or black color with fine, parallel lines suggesting a fabric texture. The background of the main image is plain and cream-colored, bordered by a faint rectangular outline. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, lighter sketch of the same chair, shown with labeled measurements in a simple line-drawing style. At the bottom right of the main composition, there is a handwritten signature and date.
title: Chair
